urdu.name: خلوصی
urdu.long_meaning: Hulusi (خلوصی) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم خلوصی، خلوص سے منسوب ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

hindi.name: ख़ुलूसी

arabic.name: خُلُوصِي
arabic.long_meaning: Hulusi (خُلُوصِي) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي خُلُوصِيّ، مَنْسُوبٌ إِلَى الْخُلُوص. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

name_story.story: Hulusi can be understood through the Arabic form خُلُوصِي, whose central sense is hulusi; of sincerity (relative form). Hulusi is the Turkish form of Arabic خُلُوصِيّ (Khulūṣī), the relative form of خُلُوص (sincerity), used as a male given name.

faq.a: Hulusi is associated with the Arabic form خُلُوصِي, whose core sense is hulusi; of sincerity (relative form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Hulusi?
faq.a: Hulusi is associated with Arabic. Hulusi is the Turkish form of Arabic خُلُوصِيّ (Khulūṣī), the relative form of خُلُوص (sincerity), used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form خُلُوصِي is Arabic.
Hulusi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Hulusi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Khulūṣī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Hulusi mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Hulusi is rendered خلوصی and carries the sense خلوصی، خلوص سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Hulusi mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hulusi is rendered خلوصی and carries the sense خلوصی، منسوب به خلوص.
A romanized syllable approximation is hu-lu-si. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hulusi?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hulusi, hulusi. Script forms are خلوصي, خلوصی, خُلُوصِي, ख़ुलूसी.

faq.q: Is Hulusi a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
